circuit.name: Four Switch Buck Boost DC-DC Converter
circuit.description: Non-inverting four-switch buck-boost converter for seamless step-up/step-down operation. Converts 12V input to 8V output in buck-boost transition mode where all four switches are actively switching. Left leg (SW1/SW2) acts as the buck input stage; right leg (SW3/SW4) acts as the boost output stage. Suited for automotive USB-C PD and battery management where input voltage crosses the output voltage threshold.

requirements.requirement: Output voltage regulation at 8V in buck-boost transition mode; verify continuity across mode boundaries
Efficiency with all four switches active; compare to single-mode buck/boost equivalent
Peak voltage and current stress on all four switches and inductor; SW3 now sees reduced voltage stress since source is at output node (not ground reference)

data.name: Vsw_left_max
data.description: Peak left switch node voltage (between SW1 source and GND)

plot.title: Right Bridge Switch Node (LX2) - SW3 Drain Stress

data.name: Vsw_right_max
data.description: Peak right switch node voltage (SW3 drain-source stress = LX2 to output voltage)

outputs.description: Peak left switch node voltage (standard buck-boost stress)
Peak right switch voltage stress (SW3 Vds = LX2 to output, reduced from full VIN swing)
Peak output voltage (SW3 source node reference)
Maximum peak current across all four switches
